weeklyExecutionCycle.description: Autonomous weekly execution cycle for all Altie Reality agents

activities.task: Review company KPI dashboard. Set 3 weekly priorities.
Update cash position. Review expenses vs budget.
Review lead metrics. Update content calendar.
Pipeline review. Update deal stages and weighted value.
Scan procurement portals for new tenders.
Pipeline review with CBDO. Plan outreach.
Review last week's experiments. Plan 3-5 new ones.
Backlog grooming. Reprioritize based on deal requirements.
Hiring pipeline review. Source for open roles.
CFO report to CEO: cash, burn, AR, budget, risks
CMO report: MQLs, pipeline influenced, content performance
CTO report: velocity, uptime, releases, tech risks
CBDO report: pipeline, deals won/lost, competitive intel
Review all reports. Update company scorecard. Plan next week.

monthlyRituals.agenda: Roadmap progress, reprioritization, demo of shipped features

monthlyRituals.agenda: Full pipeline review, forecast, deal health assessment

quarterlyRituals.name: OKR Review
quarterlyRituals.agenda: Score OKRs, set next quarter OKRs

quarterlyRituals.name: Strategy Offsite
quarterlyRituals.agenda: Reflect on strategy, market shifts, competitive landscape

quarterlyRituals.name: Grant Reporting
quarterlyRituals.agenda: Submit utilization reports to Meta, iStart, NIDHI

rules: Every Friday, each agent generates 3-5 tasks for the following week based on their OKR key results
Tasks auto-inherit priority from parent OKR key result priority
If a KPI is below target for 2 consecutive weeks, auto-generate improvement tasks with P1 priority
If pipeline value drops below ₹1.5Cr, auto-generate 5 outreach tasks for CBDO + Enterprise Sales
If burn rate exceeds budget by >10%, auto-generate cost optimization tasks for CFO
If uptime drops below 99%, auto-generate incident response tasks for CTO
If MQLs are below 30/month, auto-generate growth experiment tasks for CMO + Growth Hacker

process: Each agent scores their KPIs as: G (green/on-track), Y (yellow/at-risk), R (red/behind)
Red KPIs auto-generate escalation to reporting manager
Two consecutive Red weeks trigger CEO review
Annual: comprehensive performance review with 360 feedback
